text: Scope decision: keep Grid[F,D] and Affine[D] explicitly equal-dimensional (D2-in-D2 or D3-in-D3) and introduce AffineIso[D] as the semantic alias. A future D2-in-D3 plane must use separately named AffineEmbedding[I,W]/EmbeddedGrid[F,I,W] types; existing coordinate meaning will not change. Native slices are represented today as D3 grids with singleton extent or as downstream geometry, and dimension-dropping embedded slices remain out of this core scope. The alternative Grid[F,I,W] would immediately add an ambient parameter across Sampled and the extensive reframe4s Grid/Affine consumer surface, while the locus adapter only needs finite grid indices; that migration cost is not justified before a concrete embedded-plane consumer exists.
